content: The website's code, [published on GitHub](${projectUrl}), is released under the [Unlicense](${UNLICENSE_URL}).
This includes static content like text and images that are part of the code repository, as well as artifacts produced from them during the build process.
Refer to the repository for more detailed information.
The build artifacts also include the following:
* The icons that are not part of the code are taken from the [BoxIcons project](${boxIconsUrl}) and are licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](${cc4ByUrl}).
The server-side code depends mostly on the [node.js](${nodeUrl}) standard library, but also on a few libraries with permissive licenses.
Again, refer to the repository for more information.
Finally, "dynamic" content that is not part of the website's code is distributed under different conditions:
* For the files under [**/files**](/files), I try to elaborate their copyright status on the pages that link to them.
* The files under [**/pacman**](/pacman) are archives that contain the corresponding copyright status inside them.
